title: Resolve maxPrimeGap_le sorry via BddAbove for prime gaps

problemStatement.plain: Extends the Erdos 1138 prime gap formalization with proved bounds: prime gaps are bounded above (BddAbove via gap <= x), Bertrand's postulate gives gap <= prev_prime, maxPrimeGap <= x/2 for x >= 25, Cramer's C*(log x)^2 = o(x) sublinearity, and monotonicity. All former axioms and sorries resolved. Baker-Harman-Pintz x^0.525 bound axiomized.
